import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static final int maxn = 20;
    static final int N = 2001000;
    static int[] f = new int[N];
    static int[] g = new int[N];
    static int[] b = new int[N];
    static int[] mp = new int[N];
    static int[] tot = new int[maxn];
    static int[] prob_1 = new int[N];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[maxn];

    static int pow(int a, int b) {
        int ans = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) ans = (int)((long)ans * a % mod);
            a = (int)((long)a * a % mod);
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int inv(int a) {
        return pow(a, mod - 2);
    }

    static void reduce(int[] a, int i) {
        if (a[i] >= mod) a[i] -= mod;
        else if (a[i] < 0) a[i] += mod;
    }

    static int pc(int x) {
        return Integer.bitCount(x);
    }

    static void fwt(int[] a, int lim) {
        if ((lim /= 2) == 0) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < lim; ++i) {
            a[i] += a[i + lim];
            if (a[i] >= mod) a[i] -= mod;
        }
        fwt(a, lim);
        fwt(a, lim + lim);
    }

    static void fwt2(int[] a, int lim) {
        if ((lim /= 2) == 0) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < lim; ++i) {
            a[i] -= a[i + lim];
            if (a[i] < 0) a[i] += mod;
        }
        fwt2(a, lim);
        fwt2(a, lim + lim);
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] a, int n) {
        int i = n - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && a[i] >= a[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        int j = n - 1;
        while (a[j] <= a[i]) j--;
        int tmp = a[i];
        a[i] = a[j];
        a[j] = tmp;
        for (int l = i + 1, r = n - 1; l < r; l++, r--) {
            tmp = a[l];
            a[l] = a[r];
            a[r] = tmp;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int[][] a = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                a[i][j] = in.nextInt();
                a[i][j] = (int)((long)a[i][j] * inv(100) % mod);
                b[i * n + j] = a[i][j];
                prob_1[i * n + j] = a[i][j];
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; ++i) v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); ++i) {
            int cnt = pc(i);
            v[cnt].add(i);
            mp[i] = tot[cnt]++;
        }

        int m = n / 2;
        int M = n - m;

        // First half
        int size1 = 1 << (m * n);
        for (int i = 0; i < size1; ++i) {
            int p = 1;
            int[] S = new int[m];
            for (int j = 0; j < m * n; ++j) {
                if ((i >> j & 1) == 1) p = (int)((long)p * prob_1[j] % mod);
                else p = (int)((long)p * (mod + 1 - prob_1[j]) % mod);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                S[j] = (i >> (j * n)) & ((1 << n) - 1);
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int j : v[m]) {
                int[] s = new int[m];
                int tot2 = 0;
                int k = j;
                while (k != 0) {
                    int lsb = k & -k;
                    s[tot2++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(k);
                    k ^= lsb;
                }
                Arrays.sort(s, 0, m);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < m; ++jj) {
                        if ((S[jj] >> s[jj] & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) st |= 1 << mp[j];
                } while (nextPermutation(s, m));
            }
            f[st] = (f[st] + p) % mod;
        }

        // Second half
        int size2 = 1 << (M * n);
        for (int i = 0; i < size2; ++i) {
            int p = 1;
            int[] S = new int[M];
            for (int j = 0; j < M * n; ++j) {
                if ((i >> j & 1) == 1) p = (int)((long)p * prob_1[j + n * m] % mod);
                else p = (int)((long)p * (mod + 1 - prob_1[j + n * m]) % mod);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < M; ++j) {
                S[j] = (i >> (j * n)) & ((1 << n) - 1);
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int j : v[n - m]) {
                int[] s = new int[M];
                int tot2 = 0;
                int k = j;
                while (k != 0) {
                    int lsb = k & -k;
                    s[tot2++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(k);
                    k ^= lsb;
                }
                Arrays.sort(s, 0, M);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < M; ++jj) {
                        if ((S[jj] >> s[jj] & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) st |= 1 << mp[(~j) & ((1 << n) - 1)];
                } while (nextPermutation(s, M));
            }
            g[st] = (g[st] + p) % mod;
        }

        int ans = 0;
        int lim = 1 << tot[m];
        fwt(f, lim);
        fwt(g, lim);
        for (int i = 0; i < lim; ++i) f[i] = (int)((long)f[i] * g[i] % mod);
        fwt2(f, lim);
        for (int i = 1; i < lim; ++i) ans = (ans + f[i]) % mod;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
